data_fields.name: max_parent_depth
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (FUNCPARSER_MAX_NESTING = 20 caps $func nesting only)

data_fields.name: code_rows_editable
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: code-defined rows cannot be edited

best_idea: Author content as named rows that inherit from a parent row by key, validate the whole chain at save time with the same validator the spawner uses, and make code-shipped base rows read-only.
decision_why: Legends and zones are rows with a few inheritable fields, and the editor needs one validator for preview and save; reject the $func string-evaluation layer since legend rows need no inline expressions.
acceptance: A staff editor saves a legend row with a parent and sees its flattened stats before publish; saving a row whose parent chain loops returns an error and nothing is written (server test: saveRow returns errors and the store is unchanged).
